newsitem.title: THAILAND: Sri Dhana shares suspended after fire.
newsitem.headline: Sri Dhana shares suspended after fire.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand on Monday suspended trade in shares of Sri Dhana Finance Plc on the company's request after fire broke out on Sunday in its new office in the 36-storey President Tower.
Sri Dhana Finance is majority owned by the Srivikorn family which owns the building that caught fire in central Bangkok.
Sri Dhana Finance was scheduled to move into the new head office today, company officials said.
The building was due to open from this week and workers said there were two blasts on the seventh floor before the fire began. Three people died in the fire.
Ninety-three workers were plucked from the roof of the burning building by police helicopters in a four-hour operation.
Sri Dhana on Friday closed up 0.25 baht at 10.50.
